department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
benefit: Accident insurance. If you die in an accident, your family gets Rs 2,00,000. If you lose both eyes, both hands or feet, or one eye and one hand or foot, you get Rs 2,00,000. If you lose one eye or one hand or foot, you get Rs 1,00,000. You pay Rs 20 a year from your bank or post office account.

other: You must have a savings account in a bank or post office that takes part.
You can join through one account only.

how_to_apply: Fill the form at your bank or post office and agree to auto-debit of Rs 20 each year. The cover runs from 1 June to 31 May.
